description: This file defines the NoteViewHolder class for a RecyclerView, managing the display and interaction of note items including title, content, tags, attachments, and status indicators in an Android app.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying notes, managing UI updates for title, content, tags, attachments, and status indicators, with support for selection state changes.

methods.name: updateBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the note item based on the NoteColor.

methods.name: updateTags
methods.description: Updates the tag views displayed for the note, reusing views to optimize performance.

methods.name: updateIndicatorIcons
methods.description: Updates visibility of status indicator icons based on note properties and search mode.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the note's title text and visibility.

methods.name: setTextContent
methods.description: Displays the note's content, rendering markdown if enabled, or plain text otherwise.

methods.name: setTasks
methods.description: Displays a list of tasks associated with the note, with a limit and 'more' indicator.

methods.name: setupAttachments
methods.description: Prepares and displays note attachments, limiting to 4 and showing remaining count if any.

methods.name: runPayloads
methods.description: Updates specific parts of the view based on changed payloads.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the view, updating all UI components accordingly.

methods.name: onSelectedStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates the view's appearance based on selection state.
